programmes.d: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Shiro must come to Saber's aid when unleashing her Noble Phantasm, Excalibur, leaves her drained.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
Shiro gets a glimpse into Saber's past and is captured by Ilya.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Archer battles Berserker so Rin, Shiro and Saber can escape.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Shiro gives part of his magical circuit to Saber so that she may replenish her mana.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Shiro manages to find a weapon powerful enough to defeat Berserker.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
Sakura is captured by Caster to use as a sacrifice that will summon the Holy Grail.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Shirou, Rin, and Saber make an attempt to rescue Sakura and prevent the Holy Grail's summoning.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
Saber reveals the identity of the eighth servant after Shiro and the others escape.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
Shiro realizes his feelings for Saber and asks her on a date.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
Shirou and Saber are attacked by the Servant Gilgamesh.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
Kirei orders Lancer and Gilgamesh to kill Shirou and Saber.
The Elementario fairies are a little frazzled as they attempt to work on a new show, and they just can't work together! Will they finally be able to become a team?
Shiro goes after Kirei and Saber battles Gilgamesh.
The visitor count steadily escalates following the grand opening of the park's night time operations. Later, Kanie discovers the grave consequence should he fail in his task.
Shiro and Saber combine their powers to battle Gilgamesh and Kirei.
Hinata reminiscences about his past. Maid Latte hosts a Fortune Telling Day and Erika the fortune teller gives Usui a depressing fortune regarding his future with Misaki.
The fate of the world rests with a skirt-chasing teenager called Ataru Moroboshi; a love-struck Oni alien princess Lum comes between Ataru and Shinobu.
At the festival together, Misaki and Usui end up joining the Love Trial. The prize: a ticket to the after-party, and the only rule is that they must hold hands the whole time!
Sakura's crazy exorcism ritual does Ataru more harm than good; Ataru gets more than he bargained for when he uses power-dampening yellow ribbons on Lum.
Misaki, the iron-fisted student council president, hides a secret: she works in a maid cafe! She's discovered by the most popular guy in school; what's his price for silence?
Shutaro becomes the apple of every girl's eye and, by extension, a prick to every boy; Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and Shutaro struggle to find a way out of a labyrinthine cave.
Misaki's secret is spreading; now the Three Idiots are onto her too! Worse, the school festival's coming, and Class 2-2's about to rebel! One single mistake could expose her!

Ataru and Shutaro emerge as potential mates for the crow aliens' very own sleeping beauty. While one steals the customary kiss, the other captures her heart simply by being in the right place at the right time.
It's Little Sister Day at the cafe. Misaki can't get into the role, but a severe scolding by Honoka makes her turn her act around. Misaki nails the parté until Takumi arrives.
A cursed boxing glove sends Ataru on a hugging spree and gets him into trouble; Ataru is dancing on air after reading a love letter from a secret admirer.
The cafe gets a celebrity guest: Aoi, a net idol. She's eager to work in the cafe, much to Satsuki's chagrin. When Takumi helps out in the kitchen, Aoi sets her sights on him!

Playing for the Oni aliens, Ataru sets his flirtatious sights on Benten from the rival team; Ataru has a snowy encounter with Lum's Neptune-based friend, Oyuki; Ataru's vague announcement sparks wild speculations.
Satsuki warns Misaki about a group of stalkers targeting cosplay cafes, but she isn't worried. On this night, however, the boss is late and Misaki has to close shop alone.
All Ataru wants is Sakura in his arms, but all he gets is a lonely monster holding his hands underwater; an unexpected new beginning awaits the lonely monster at the beach.
Misaki has new fans at school- the Inuyama brothers. They want to know all about her, but this will reveal her secret. Should she tell them the truth and risk her reputation?
Lum's vindictive friend Ran intends to use a clueless and kissy-faced Ataru to settle an old score; Ataru goes to Ran's party like a lamb to the slaughter.
Misaki breaks up a fight between students from Seika High and Miyabigaoka Academy. When she brings the Seika students to Miyabigaoka to apologize, Takumi tags along.
Overloaded with good looks and physical strength, an old flame comes back into Lum's life to wreak havoc; Shutaro loses the spotlight at school.
Misaki's torn over Miyabigaoka's surprise offer. When she finally goes to give her reply, her friends worry Seika High wouldn't be where it is today without her.
The impish Ryoko Mendo scares the bejesus out of Ataru and gets on Shutaro's nerves; Ataru and his friends are in for a tumultuous New Year's celebration.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
The fate of the world rests with a skirt-chasing teenager called Ataru Moroboshi; a love-struck Oni alien princess Lum comes between Ataru and Shinobu.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Sakura's crazy exorcism ritual does Ataru more harm than good; Ataru gets more than he bargained for when he uses power-dampening yellow ribbons on Lum.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Shutaro becomes the apple of every girl's eye and, by extension, a prick to every boy; Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and Shutaro struggle to find a way out of a labyrinthine cave.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.

Ataru and Shutaro emerge as potential mates for the crow aliens' very own sleeping beauty. While one steals the customary kiss, the other captures her heart simply by being in the right place at the right time.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.

All Ataru wants is Sakura in his arms, but all he gets is a lonely monster holding his hands underwater; an unexpected new beginning awaits the lonely monster at the beach.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Lum's vindictive friend Ran intends to use a clueless and kissy-faced Ataru to settle an old score; Ataru goes to Ran's party like a lamb to the slaughter.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
Overloaded with good looks and physical strength, an old flame comes back into Lum's life to wreak havoc; Shutaro loses the spotlight at school.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
The impish Ryoko Mendo scares the bejesus out of Ataru and gets on Shutaro's nerves; Ataru and his friends are in for a tumultuous New Year's celebration.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
Life for Ayato Kamina seems normal enough, but when wars hits close to home, the life he once knew changes forever.
When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It's awkward for everyone involved.
With the RahXephon awakened, the tide of war seems as if it is about to change; under the control of Ayato, the RahXephon easily eliminates the invading Dolem.
Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.
Ayato discovers the shocking truth: his mother has blue blood; the RahXephon destroys another Dolem and creates a passage from Tokyo to the outside.
After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
The pair have left the safety of Tokyo and now live on the outside; Ayato and Haruka are picked up by TERRA, the military group that she is a member of.
Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
Ayato proves that he can be trusted after taking care of the Dolem threat; Ayato is taken to a new home.
Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
Ayato has a tense first meeting with Kim; Watari holds a press conference.
When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
Makoto Isshiki, who calls himself an observer, is brought in to join with TERRA; his true purpose seems questionable.
Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...
Itsuki's innocent gift to Nanamori turns out to be a threat.
Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She'll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.
Ayato sees a woman that he believes to be Reika; he and Quon go to investigate.
Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
Itsuki experiments with music to grow plants; a piece of music that Quon has been playing recently has had a rather strange effect on them.
Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith's sealed space will help her. Maybe.
Ayato's systems go critical during a battle, threatening his survival.
A chaotic summer break ends, and a new school semester begins with Mikan transferring into Shamiko's class.
Quon falls into a strange catatonic state and is hospitalized; to everyone's surprise, she suddenly vanishes, and the search is on to find out where she went.
Itsuki claims that Quon is his sister, but other information surfaces that indicate otherwise.
Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse!
Forces make a move to take control of Quon; TERRA gains use of a new weapon, the Vermillion.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
Three young children study within their master's vast mansion; one child finds a Dolem living in the ruins beneath and wants to protect it.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
